READABILITY.evidence: The code is well organised, with section banners and Chinese comments on pricing rules and tx. But business logic is full of single-letter names: `var S`, `f = findVariant(sku)`, `l`, `c`, `o`, `r`, `q`, `t`, `fr`, `pv`. The single-letter cap applies.

MAINTAINABILITY.evidence: Everything is in one ~1550-line file, which hits the >500-line cap. The single delegated `document.addEventListener('click', …)` switch handles every action (export, import, reset, rf-restock, refund, …) and is well over 100 lines. Core/quote/tx separation is good, but the cap applies.

ROBUSTNESS.evidence: `persist(){ try{ localStorage.setItem(...) } catch(e){ /* 存储不可用时忽略 */ } }` silently drops save failures on every mutation path. `wrap` and `export` also use empty catches. tx rollback and input validation (`isPosInt`, `normQty`) are solid, but the swallowed-mutation-error cap applies.

C9-01-CASE1.evidence: Discounts are itemised with labels ('会员 95 折', coupon name/code), plus the coupon shortfall ('还差'), stacking rules and a refund preview. Pay, ship, cancel, refund, restock, import and reset all open confirmBox with plain-language warnings. Status badges and per-status actions are shown, and toasts/alerts give feedback.

C9-01-CASE2.evidence: shopTestAPI calls `Core.*` directly, the same functions the UI uses. Money is stored in integer cents (`toC`/`toY`, `Math.round`). Stats come from `Core.stats()` computed from orders each time. Import goes through `parseImport`/validation before anything is replaced, and tx snapshots and rolls back on failure.
